mechanism_narrative: The two-week upward trend in PARKS from -13.7 to +3.7 signals normalized outdoor leisure, which historically spills over into adjacent retail and recreation trips. Continued PARKS strength predicts higher RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -13.7 to +3.7 over t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS remains above 0 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the last 14 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A policy-driven relaxation of transit constraints becomes visible when TRANSIT crosses above -25 percent from baseline. That crossing lowers travel friction for retail trips, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT exceeds -25.0 for two consecutive weekly means
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stabilized at -27.1 after falling to -36.6
failure_condition: If TRANSIT crosses above -25.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not higher than over the last 14 days, the hypothesis fails.
